description: Header file defining the SimpleSynchronousEntry class and related data structures for managing disk cache entries in Chromium's net disk cache implementation.

classes.name: SimpleEntryStat
classes.description: Class representing metadata about cache entry file offsets and sizes.

classes.name: SimpleStreamPrefetchData
classes.description: Structure holding prefetch data for a stream.

classes.name: SimpleEntryCreationResults
classes.description: Results of creating or opening a cache entry, including pointers to the entry and prefetch data.

classes.name: SimpleEntryCloseResults
classes.description: Results related to closing a cache entry, such as estimated trailer prefetch size.

classes.name: SimpleSynchronousEntry
classes.description: Main class managing synchronous disk cache entries, including opening, creating, reading, writing, and closing entries.

methods.name: SimpleSynchronousEntry
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a cache entry object.

methods.name: ~SimpleSynchronousEntry
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up cache entry object.

methods.name: OpenEntry
methods.description: Opens an existing cache entry from disk.

methods.name: CreateEntry
methods.description: Creates a new cache entry on disk.

methods.name: OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Opens an existing or creates a new cache entry.

methods.name: Doom
methods.description: Renames the entry to prevent further access, effectively deleting it.

methods.name: DeleteEntryFiles
methods.description: Deletes cache entry files from disk.

methods.name: TruncateEntryFiles
methods.description: Truncates cache entry files without deleting.

methods.name: DeleteEntrySetFiles
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache entries based on key hashes.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the cache entry.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the cache entry.

methods.name: CheckEOFRecord
methods.description: Checks the EOF record in a cache file.

methods.name: ReadSparseData
methods.description: Reads sparse data associated with the cache entry.

methods.name: WriteSparseData
methods.description: Writes sparse data associated with the cache entry.

methods.name: GetAvailableRange
methods.description: Gets available data range in sparse data.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the cache entry, writing EOF records and updating state.
